## Checklist

- [ ] Added item(s) follow the format: `- [Product name](url) - Description starting with capital, ending in period.`
- [ ] Items are added in alphabetical order within the section
- [ ] URLs are HTTPS and point to the official product/homepage
- [ ] The product is AI-native: an LLM is the product, not a feature bolted onto an existing tool
- [ ] Descriptions explain *what the product does* and *what makes it AI-native* (not just a marketing tagline)
- [ ] The product is actively maintained and still live
- [ ] No duplicate entries
